gaps: AMC developer credentials were not available, so live Phase 5 dogfood is explicitly skipped.
The official Showtime API contract exposes read operations only; ticket purchase, seat selection, and payment remain outside this CLI.

novel_features.name: Movie plan
novel_features.description: Find, filter, and rank AMC showtimes by theatre or current location without purchasing tickets.
novel_features.rationale: It turns AMC's low-level showtime reads into one deterministic answer to a movie-night planning request.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can return a short ranked set of relevant screenings without inventing purchase capabilities.

narrative.headline: Official AMC showtimes and movie-night planning from an agent-ready CLI.
narrative.value_prop: Query every documented AMC Showtime API v2 read operation or get a ranked movie plan by theatre or location, with explicit production and sandbox support.
narrative.auth_narrative: Create an AMC developer application, set its vendor key, optionally set a user authorization token, and choose production or sandbox.

quickstart.comment: Rank evening showtimes at one AMC theatre.
Find nearby IMAX screenings and rank them by distance and start time.

troubleshoots.symptom: The API reports that the vendor key is missing or invalid.
troubleshoots.fix: Run auth setup and export AMC_THEATRES_VENDOR_KEY from the official AMC developer portal.

troubleshoots.symptom: A sandbox credential is being sent to production.
troubleshoots.fix: Set AMC_THEATRES_ENV=sandbox; explicit custom base URLs remain unchanged for tests and controlled deployments.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to inspect AMC showtimes, find a movie's earliest screening, or prepare a ranked read-only movie plan.
anti_triggers: Do not claim the CLI purchased a ticket, selected a seat, or submitted payment.
Do not use a production credential against the sandbox or a sandbox credential against production.

recipes.title: Plan a movie at one theatre
recipes.explanation: Queries dated theatre showtimes, filters the movie and earliest time, and ranks matching screenings.

recipes.title: Find nearby premium-format showtimes
recipes.explanation: Queries AMC's current-location view and ranks matching premium-format screenings by distance and time.

find an IMAX showing at AMC
